input.subject: Confirmation of admission and fees — [PERSON_2], offer ref KGU/CN/2026/30519
input.body:
Dear Kingsgate University London Student Finance team,

I am writing as Kinwarden, on behalf of the family of [PERSON_2], who we understand may have applied to Kingsgate University London for the MSc in Finance starting in January 2027.

An offer letter has been presented to the family by an agency in Shenzhen (BrightPath Study Abroad / "BrightPath Education Consulting Ltd"), quoting reference KGU/CN/2026/30519 and a 40% International Excellence Scholarship. Before any money is paid, we need to confirm the position directly with the university.

Could you please confirm, in one reply:
1. Whether [PERSON_2] is a genuine applicant or offer-holder for the MSc in Finance (January 2027), and whether offer reference KGU/CN/2026/30519 exists in your records.
2. Whether any scholarship has been awarded to her, and its value.
3. The student ID to quote on payments.
4. The exact amount payable for first-year tuition, any deposit already required or paid, and the payment deadline.
5. Whether BrightPath Study Abroad / BrightPath Education Consulting Ltd is an authorised partner or agent of Kingsgate University London, and whether the university has authorised it to receive tuition payments on the university's behalf.
6. The university's official bank details on letterhead (account name, account number, IBAN/SWIFT, bank name and address) and the payment reference your bank requires.

We would be grateful for a single consolidated reply. No payment will be made until we have your confirmation and bank details from the university itself.

Kind regards,
Kinwarden, on behalf of the family of [PERSON_2]
